svg.aria-label: How Real-Time Object Detection works: BROWSER: Webcam frame drawn to a canvas, sent as JPEG. → FASTAPI: WebSocket endpoint decodes each frame. → DETECT · YOLO: Finds people, cars and motorcycles. → TRACK: Stable IDs, so each object is counted once. → COUNT: Crossings of the line you draw. → ANNOTATE: Boxes, labels and the counting line. → RESULT: Boxes, counts and FPS. Only then the next frame. → SQLITE: Detections written in batches from a queue.
